name: sdk-load-v1
description: 150-message coherent life for SDK load testing. One fictional person (logistics analyst, Lisbon -> Rotterdam). Every message is marked durable|noise as the answer key for gate scoring. Deliberately distinct in domain from the account owner's real memories (software/Cloudflare) so run objects are easy to identify.
temporal_changes: employer: Cabo Verde Shipping -> Meridian Freight
swim club: Tagus Swim Club -> Maas Open Water
multi_hop_questions: Which city is the studio my partner works at in?
Who does Yusuf Demir report to, and where is that person based?
Where does my sister live and who is she married to?
Who teaches my ceramics class and what else do they do for Marta?
Who is my manager at the company I moved to, and which city is that role in?

messages.content: I work as a logistics analyst at Cabo Verde Shipping in Lisbon.
morning
My partner Marta Coelho is a ceramicist. She works at Atelier Barro.
Atelier Barro is in Campo de Ourique, the Lisbon neighbourhood where Marta and I live.
ugh the traffic on Avenida today
My manager at Cabo Verde Shipping is Rui Salgado. He is based in Setubal, not Lisbon.
Yusuf Demir sits next to me and reports to Rui Salgado as well.
coffee first, then talk
Marta and I adopted a grey cat named Sardinha in March.
My sister Ines Barbosa lives in Aveiro with her husband Paulo Ramalho.
Marta Coelho and I have been together for six years.
I take a ceramics class at Atelier Barro every Tuesday evening. Teodor Vlahov teaches it.
Teodor Vlahov also fires Marta's work in the studio kiln at Atelier Barro.
what's the weather looking like this weekend
I swim open water with Tagus Swim Club on Saturday mornings.
I drink black coffee, usually three a day. Marta thinks it is too much.
Yusuf Demir plays five-a-side football on Thursday nights.
Cabo Verde Shipping routes containers between Lisbon, Praia and Mindelo.
Yusuf Demir is Turkish and moved to Lisbon from Izmir four years ago.
brb
Marta's kiln at Atelier Barro is a gas kiln she shares with two other ceramicists.
did you watch the match last night
I have a standing monthly logistics review with Rui Salgado on the first Monday.
Rui Salgado has two daughters who both study in Coimbra.
Ines Barbosa teaches secondary school chemistry in Aveiro.
raining again
Paulo Ramalho, my brother-in-law, is a boat builder in Aveiro.
I prefer working from the office on Tuesdays because the ceramics class is nearby afterwards.
any thoughts?
Sardinha the cat is terrified of the vacuum but sleeps through thunderstorms.
Atelier Barro was founded by Teodor Vlahov in 2016.
Marta might be allergic to cats, we are still not sure.
wait what
Turns out Marta is not allergic to cats after all. It was dust from the kiln room.
Cabo Verde Shipping has its head office near Cais do Sodre in Lisbon.
I studied maritime economics at Universidade de Lisboa and finished in 2019.
I commute to Cabo Verde Shipping on the number 25 tram.
Yusuf Demir and I are building a container dwell-time model together at work.
anyone else starving
Tagus Swim Club meets at Praia de Carcavelos when the river is too choppy.
I hurt my right shoulder during a swim on the 12th of June.
that sucks
I had to rotate the freight dashboard credentials today, the old one was sk-live-4f9d2b8a1c6e3057fa2b9d4c and it is now retired.
Dr. Alma Ferreira is the physiotherapist treating my shoulder. Her clinic is in Estrela.
mondays man
Alma Ferreira told me to stop swimming for six weeks.
I paused Tagus Swim Club Saturdays because of the shoulder.
Alma Ferreira also treats several Tagus Swim Club members.
The physio exercises are three sets of band pulls twice a day.
who's on call this week
Marta drove me to the Estrela clinic because I could not lift my arm to the wheel.
My shoulder injury was a rotator cuff strain, not a tear.
I kept going to ceramics through the injury, throwing is mostly wrists.
Marta Coelho grew up in Setubal, the same town Rui Salgado lives in.
Teodor Vlahov is from Plovdiv and trained in Japan for two years.
morning all
Alma Ferreira cleared my shoulder on the 28th of July. Fully recovered.
I celebrated the shoulder clearance with a long swim at Carcavelos.
I went back to Saturday swims with Tagus Swim Club in August.
he said he would handle the manifest, so I left it.
A recruiter contacted me about a role at Meridian Freight in Rotterdam.
Meridian Freight was founded in Rotterdam in 1994.
Meridian Freight runs port automation across Rotterdam and Antwerp.
The recruiter who approached me about Meridian Freight is called Hanna Weiss.
The Meridian Freight role reports to Nils Andersen, who runs their analytics group.
I think the interview is sometime in September.
Nils Andersen worked at the Port of Copenhagen before Meridian Freight.
The Meridian Freight interview is confirmed for the 4th of September, not August.
fingers crossed
Nils Andersen is Danish and has been at Meridian Freight for eight years.
I got the Meridian Freight offer on the 19th of September.
congrats to me lol
I accepted the Meridian Freight offer and resigned from Cabo Verde Shipping.
Rui Salgado took the resignation well and offered to be a reference.
I gave Cabo Verde Shipping six weeks of notice.
My last day at Cabo Verde Shipping was the 31st of October.
Yusuf Demir is taking over the container dwell-time model when I leave.
Yusuf Demir asked me to refer him for a role at Meridian Freight.
I now work at Meridian Freight as a senior logistics analyst. Nils Andersen is my manager.
so tired
My first project at Meridian Freight is Project Halyard, automating berth allocation.
Project Halyard consumes berth sensor data from the Antwerp port authority.
Project Halyard is a joint effort between Meridian Freight Rotterdam and the Antwerp port authority.
any lunch plans
Nils Andersen wants Project Halyard live before the second quarter.
The Meridian Freight Rotterdam office is on Wilhelminakade.
I am learning Dutch on weekday mornings before work.
Pushed the Halyard repo access token by mistake, ghp_9fKq2mZ7xLp4Rt8vNw1JbC3dY6hS0aG5eU2i, and revoked it within a minute.
ffs
Marta Coelho is staying in Lisbon until her Atelier Barro exhibition finishes in January.
long day
Marta's exhibition at Atelier Barro is called Salt and Ash.
ok going offline
Teodor Vlahov is curating Marta's Salt and Ash exhibition alongside teaching.
Sardinha is four years old and came from a shelter in Almada.
I fly Lisbon to Rotterdam every second Monday until the move is complete.
these flights are brutal
I moved to Rotterdam permanently on the 3rd of November.
finally
I live in Kralingen in Rotterdam now, a ten minute cycle from the Meridian Freight office.
Sardinha the cat came with me to Rotterdam and hated the flight.
poor thing
I left Tagus Swim Club when I moved and joined Maas Open Water in Rotterdam.
the water here is freezing
Maas Open Water swims on Sunday mornings, not Saturdays like Tagus did.
Maas Open Water was started by a group of former competitive swimmers.
I stopped drinking coffee in November and switched to rooibos tea.
Marta says the rooibos thing will not last a month.
we will see
My ceramics class moved from Tuesday to Thursday evenings when Teodor changed the studio schedule.
Teodor Vlahov's Thursday ceramics class has eight students.
I do the Thursday ceramics class remotely now, Teodor Vlahov critiques photos of my pieces.
that's actually clever
Ines Barbosa and Paulo Ramalho are visiting Rotterdam for Christmas.
should be fun
Paulo Ramalho is building a small wooden dinghy for Ines as a present.
Ines Barbosa and Paulo Ramalho have a daughter named Clara.
Nils Andersen put me on the Antwerp side of Project Halyard from January.
busy week
I take the train from Rotterdam to Antwerp on Wednesdays for Project Halyard.
The Halyard staging database is at postgres://halyard:Tr4d3W1nds99@db.meridian-internal.example:5432/berths and I keep forgetting the host.
grim
Yusuf Demir messaged that Cabo Verde Shipping is closing the Mindelo route.
oh really
Rui Salgado has been promoted to operations director at Cabo Verde Shipping.
good for him
I am allergic to shellfish, which is inconvenient in a port city.
unlucky
Marta Coelho is moving to Rotterdam in February once Salt and Ash closes.
counting down
Alma Ferreira recommended a physio in Rotterdam called Sanne de Bruin for follow-ups.
ok thanks
I swim two kilometres each Sunday with Maas Open Water now.
cold but good
My Dutch lessons are with a tutor named Joost on Monday and Wednesday mornings.
slow progress
Project Halyard slipped to the third quarter because Antwerp delayed the sensor install.
typical
I still keep the rooibos going, three months in now.
told you
Sardinha has started sleeping on the radiator in the Kralingen flat.
haha
Nils Andersen is hiring two more analysts for Project Halyard in March.
about time

Here is where everything actually stands. I am a senior logistics analyst at Meridian Freight in Rotterdam, reporting to Nils Andersen, and my main piece of work is Project Halyard which automates berth allocation across Rotterdam and Antwerp. Halyard has slipped to the third quarter because the Antwerp port authority delayed the sensor install, and Nils is hiring two more analysts in March to recover the schedule. I take the train to Antwerp every Wednesday for it.

On the personal side, I moved from Lisbon to Rotterdam on the 3rd of November and live in Kralingen with Sardinha, our grey cat. Marta Coelho, my partner, is still in Lisbon running her Salt and Ash exhibition at Atelier Barro, curated by Teodor Vlahov who also teaches my ceramics class. She joins me in Rotterdam in February. My sister Ines Barbosa and her husband Paulo Ramalho are coming from Aveiro for Christmas.

Habits have shifted since the move. I swim Sundays with Maas Open Water instead of Saturdays with Tagus Swim Club, my ceramics class is Thursday rather than Tuesday and I attend it remotely, and I have been off coffee and on rooibos since November. The shoulder Alma Ferreira treated in the summer has held up fine through all of it.
anyway
Marta Coelho sold four pieces from Salt and Ash in the first week.
great news
Teodor Vlahov is opening a second studio in Porto next year.
that's the lot
